Banka Slovenije's Annual Report 2024 (bsi.si, Letno-porocilo-2024_EN_07_eng-GB_complete.pdf, section 3.9 'Management of Banka Slovenije's financial assets', read in full) mentions 'the BIS fund' EXACTLY ONCE, and in a clause about maturity: the largest maturity bucket is more than three years, '52%, including holdings in the BIS fund and of equity ETFs, which have no maturity'. A listed exchange-traded fund is a security bought on a market, not a mandate given to a manager, and no manager is named for one.
